grants.description: Verify your identity using your GOV.UK One Login credentials
grants.purpose: To confirm your identity before processing your discount application

grants.description: Allow the council to access your Council Tax records
grants.purpose: To verify you are liable for Council Tax and check your account status

grants.description: Allow the council to check the electoral register for your property
grants.purpose: To verify no other adults are registered as living at your property

grants.description: Confirm details about who lives in your property
grants.purpose: To determine if you are the only adult resident or if others are disregarded for Council Tax

grants.description: Share evidence of bereavement, separation, or change in household
grants.purpose: To verify your reason for applying for the single person discount

grants.description: Allow the council to periodically verify your continued eligibility
grants.purpose: To ensure you remain eligible for the discount and detect any changes in household composition

revocation.mechanism: Contact your local council or revoke through your GOV.UK account
revocation.effect: Your application will be cancelled if consent is revoked before completion. If discount is already granted, it will be removed from your Council Tax account.

delegation.limitations: Agent cannot make decisions about household composition without your explicit confirmation. Agent cannot confirm that other residents are students or disregarded persons without you providing evidence. Agent must flag complex living arrangements (live-in carers, shared custody, temporary absences) for human review. Agent cannot appeal a decision on your behalf.
